issues.issue: Did the officer fetter discretion by misconstruing the evidence or placing undue emphasis on why the children were not examined?
issues.applicant_position: Officer misconstrued why the children were not examined in 2008 and drew an unreasonable negative inference on the sponsor's conduct.
issues.respondent_position: Passage of time changed the family relationships; applicants are adults with ties in China and no ongoing relationship with sponsor.
issues.result_quote: the Officer did not fetter his discretion or place undue emphasis, and the Decision was reasonable.

issues.issue: Does the decision fail to accord with the H&C purposes of s.25 and the family reunification objective in s.3(1)(d)?
issues.applicant_position: Decision ignores the family reunification objective and the purpose of s.25 relief for children barred by regulation 117(9)(d).
issues.respondent_position: Officer considered the BP2 factors and found no hardship; the sponsor's separation was his choice, with little financial or emotional support.
issues.result_quote: relief under section 25(1) was not warranted because there was no ongoing relationship between the Applicants and the Sponsor
